name: Hayasaka Miori
source:
Hideyuki finds Miori on a street prostituting herself and her friends. 2000 yen a pop, cumming inside is a free service and it's ok if they get pregnant.

[spoiler]Though her friends are not so lucky she herself is a virgin and cons the men into giving her money then flees.

Hideyuki follows her, ties her up, and rapes her, then tells the men she conned where to find her . . . [/spoiler]
